Hei,
🇱🇻 Mēs sakām lielu paldies, ka apmeklēji pirmās Bolt Food kurjeru apmācības. Mūsu galvenais mērķis bija iedot nelielu ieskatu Bolt uzņēmuma un sevišķi Bolt Food piegādes pakalpojuma darbībā. Lūdzam ņemt vērā divas lietas:
1. tests un aktivizācijas anketa tiks tuvākajā laikā izskatīta un Tev tiks nosūtīta papildus informācija. Nesatraucies, ja nepaspēji uz vietas aizpildīt testu vai anketu
2. Tava Bolt Courier aplikācija tiks aktivizēta nedaudz vēlāk - vēl pāris soļi būs jāpaveic un saņemsi apstiprinājumu, ka vari slēgties klāt

🇬🇧 We thank you for participating in the 1st Bolt Food training. Our main goal was to give you a quick introduction to the service and we hope you enjoyed it. Please, keep in mind 2 things:
1. test and activation form will be reviewed in upcoming days and more information will be sent to you soon. Don’t worry if you didn’t manage to fill these on the spot
2. your Bolt Courier app account will be activated later - a few more steps ahead in upcoming days and you’ll be ready to log in

1. Форма тестирования и активации будет рассмотрена в ближайшие дни, и в ближайшее время вам будет отправлена ​​дополнительная информация. Не волнуйтесь, если вам не удалось заполнить эту форму на месте
2. Ваша учетная запись в приложении Bolt Courier будет активирована позже - еще несколько шагов вперед в ближайшие дни Вы сможете залогиниться

🇱🇻Paldies visiem, kas veiksmīgi jau ir kļuvuši par Bolt Food kurjeru. Mēs ļoti novērtējam, ka izvēlaties Bolt 🙌

Svētku laiks strauji tuvojas, un tas nozīmē, ka liela daļa iespējamo Bolt Food klientu šajā laikā nebūs aktīvi.

Mēs vēlamies būt droši, ka Bolt Food darbības uzsākšanas brīdī, Rīgā ir maksimāli daudz klientu pasūtījumi, lai kurjeri varētu gūt augstākos ienākumus. 💪

Tādēļ esam pieņēmuši lēmumu, ka piemērotākais laiks Bolt Food darbības uzsākšanai Rīgā, ir uzreiz pēc svētkiem - janvāra sākumā. Precīzu datumu izziņosim janvāra sākumā.

🇷🇺Еще раз спасибо всем за то, что стали курьером Bolt Food! 🙌
Праздничный сезон надвигается большими шагами, что означает, что многие из наших потенциальных клиентов не будут активны в течение этого времени. 

Мы хотим позаботиться о том, что мы запускаем город с максимальным кол-вом клиентов, готовыми сделать заказы, чтобы наши курьеры могли заработать больше.
Поэтому мы решили, что лучшее время для запуска Bolt Food в Риге - январь, после окончания всех празднований. Мы предоставим более подробную информацию о точной дате запуска в начале января.

🇬🇧Once again, thank you all for becoming a Bolt Food courier. We appreciate that you chose Bolt! 🙌
Holiday season is coming up in long strides, which means many of our potential customers won't be active during that time. We want to make sure we're launching the city with many customers ready to make orders so that our couriers could earn more. 💪

Therefore, we have decided that the best time to launch Riga will be in January after all celebrations have ended. We will provide more details on exact date in the beginning of January.

1. Problēmas sazvanīt atbalsta komandu Aktīvā pasūtījuma laikā ir novērstas! ✅

1. Error when calling support during Live order - ✅ Fixed now so try it today! 😌
2. Unable to start delivery? Remember to toggle the switch (See picture 👆)

❗️Please be extra careful and remember that there is food and drinks in your backpack! Use movable shelf to fix the package in the bag.
4. Reminder that it is your responsibility to register as a self-employed person.

 Tāpēc, lūdzam Tevi:

Therefore, please:
1️⃣ Carefully go through the training slides one more time
ej.uz/boltfood-training (ENG)
2️⃣ Make sure that the food is not damaged during delivery. Never put bag on the floor.
3️⃣ Remember to be positive and smile - your customers will appreciate it 😊

🍟 “McDonald’s” start preparing the food only when courier has arrived
❗️Do not forget to press “Arrived” when you get to the restaurant
🥘 “Lido” uses special pick up boxes. HOT food items will be in hotbox, other items out of the box. Take the full order! (See photo 👆)

Hei! Vai ievēroji, ka saņēmi šādu e-pastu savā pastkastē? E-pastā parādās 2 lejupielādējami dokumenti:
1. Invoice (rēķins) 
2. Report (iknedēļas atskaite)

Pievērs uzmanību, ka kurjera ienākumi sastāv no divām daļām - daļa ko samaksā klients par piegādi un piemaksa, ko saņem no Bolt atbilstoši izziņotajai samaksai par pasūtījumu. 🇬🇧📬 Weekly report from Bolt Food
Did you notice this e-mail in your mailbox? E-mail includes 2 downloadable documents:
1. Invoice
2. Report

You can conveniently see all your earnings in the Report.👌

For any kind of reporting please download and use weekly Report.

Hey! More than a month has passed since launch in Riga. Hard work has been done and a lot of things happened - we expanded delivery area for Riga, amount of orders has increased multiple times 🚀 and we introduced those long-distance premiums. 💪

In order to maintain good and reliable service to customers in Riga - we are switching our attention more towards quality. 💎 

Here are the key quality measures we look at when analysing couriers
💎 80% activity level. Look at it this way - if you reject or miss more than 2 out of 10 orders - you shouldn’t be going online.
💎 Call customer only if necessary. If you are calling customers every time you make a delivery - you are clearly ignoring customer (or restaurant) notes. Keep in mind! You can conveniently translate customer notes with Google translate if needed.
💎 Delivery to customer (also arrival to restaurant) takes too long. Golden rule - always use Waze/Google maps navigation and go straight to the destination. 

Oh, and we are talking only about your actual travel time. You don’t have to worry that you will be blamed for restaurant preparing food for too long. But if you are making a delivery and meanwhile stopping at home to take something - it’s clearly bad. Go offline and then do other things. 👌

💡If some of these are unreasonably bad - it’s possible that your courier account could be temporarily blocked or the decision can be made to terminate our cooperation - sometimes we see that courier is not skilled enough to make these kinds of deliveries. 

Other things to keep in mind:
• We deliver to the door. Don't ask customer to come downstairs. Ask - “how can I get to you?” 😊
• Always take the bag with you - never put delivery bag on the floor
• National, Latvian language comes first ('Sveiki', 'Labu Apetīti'). Be polite and positive
• Never put your own food or personal belongings in the bag in a visible way to customer
• Never contact customer after delivery 🙅‍♀️
• Always choose only the correct delivery method in the app (car, bicycle or motorbike)

Thank you for reading. And before you do something you are not sure of - always reach out to latvia-food@bolt.eu.

Sometimes you have to face situations when the order preparation time in your courier application differs from the time shown on the restaurant tablet. This can happen in situations where the restaurant always notes that they will need more time to prepare the order, but in reality the order is prepared much faster. The system understands this with time and looks for a courier at the time when the order is usually prepared. Sometimes there are situations when a restaurant really needs more time to prepare an order. In such situations, we will ask you to wait and be tolerant of the restaurant staff. It is also not necessary to report it to the customer support department, because your delivery time does not change. The system counts it from the moment you press "picked up" until you arrive at the customer. 😌

❗️Dear, courier partner! We would like to remind you of some important things so that there are no misunderstandings and unnecessary stressful situations. Every Monday, the results of the previous week are summarized and the following criteria are taken into account managing courier quality 👇

📍Your acceptance rate. You should accept at least 80% of incoming orders. This means that you can refuse or reject 10 orders out of 50 and your activity level will still be 80%. However, we encourage you to go online only when you are ready to accept orders, and don't forget to go offline when you have finished deliveries. We look at this as an average for the previous week only for those who have made 10 deliveries.
📍Your rating. Taking into account the fact that customers have the opportunity to leave a rating after you have made the delivery, this indicator is also taken into account. If at least 10 ratings have been left for you in the previous week and the average is below 80%, you will be notified about it via SMS. Think about what you could improve to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction. If in doubt and want to know your feedback from customers, contact our customer support department.
📍How fast you arrive at the restaurant compared to the time calculated by the system. We recommend you to accept orders only when you are completely ready to make deliveries. The longer you drive to the restaurant, the longer the order will wait for the courier. This is also taken as an average for the previous week and if you are late a few times you have nothing to worry about.
📍How fast you arrive at the client. Remember these important things and you will never have to worry about it. No matter how long the restaurant delays the order and even if the application shows -30 minutes, your delivery speed is not affected in any way! Your delivery time starts from the moment you pressed "Picked up" to "Arrived to customer". If the restaurant is delayed - it's not the courier's fault! Only click "Picked up" when you have entered the car and are ready to start delivery. Especially if the order has to be received from the shopping center and you will need some time to reach the car or bicycle. Click "Arrived to customer" as soon as you reach the customer's address, not after reaching his flat doors. Click "Delivered" only after you are sure that the customer has received the order. Your delivery time will be excellent if you follow these advice. We also take this as an average for the whole week. If you are stuck in a traffic jam and your delivery will be late for 5 minutes, you do not need to report it to customer support! If you have 2 orders and one of the restaurants is more than 5 minutes late - contact the customer support department immediately, asking to re-dispatch this order to another courier.
📍How fast you press "Arrived to Restaurant" and "Arrived to Customer". Click "Arrived to Restaurant" and "Arrived to Customer" only when you arrive at the address. This indicator is also taken as an average for the previous week. Must not exceed 100 m.

💡Also, don't forget: always make sure that you have taken the right order in the restaurant, if you are not sure, ask the staff, if you are still not sure, name the entire contents of the order to the restaurant staff. Deliveries are still contactless. If you are delivering two orders, make sure you are giving the right order to the customer. The customer's name will always be written on the packaging. LIDO - take the whole order - the hot will be in the thermo box, the cold - on it. We deliver only with a thermos bag. Guys and girls YOU ARE THE BEST! Thank you very much for that! 💪

❗ Important information for all couriers ❗ 

Each of us needs to do everything we can to prevent the spread of coronavirus (COVID-19) and that means avoiding close contact with individuals as possible. 

At the restaurant: 
- Please keep a distance of at least 2 metres from the restaurant staff. They will show you the order and you must take it without physical contact with the restaurant representative. - We’ve encouraged restaurants to write customer names on each food package, but double-check with the staff which order is yours to avoid confusion. 
- As always, do not touch the food. You may only touch the paper package. 
- Regularly wash your hands and use hand sanitiser. 

At the delivery address: 
- All orders must be put exactly where the Eater has requested in their courier note in the app. Pay close attention to the note in the app! 
- If no delivery spot is specified in the note, just proceed to the delivery address and call the Eater to ask where you should leave the order 
- Stay at least 2 metres away from all Eaters 
- Ensure that the Eater has taken the food order and only then press “ Delivered ” 
- If you have any issues, please contact our customer support team.

Other recommendations to couriers: 

- Wash and sanitise your hands 
- Keep the delivery bag and car / vehicle clean 
- If you feel ill, stay at home

We want to make sure the calculations of your earnings are transparent and your income reflects all the tasks you accomplish as a courier. So, we've made some improvements to our fare structure, ensuring you get paid fairly for every delivery you make. 😌

With the updated model, you will be paid for each: 
📍 Order pick-up; 
📍 Order drop-off; and
📍 Kilometre travelled from restaurant to the client.

- Pick-up - 0,70 EUR
- Drop-off - 0,70 EUR
- Distance (per km) - 0,50 EUR

0,70 EUR pick-up + 0,70 EUR drop-off + 2,00 EUR distance = 3,40 EUR

💡 At high demand periods, there may also be additional incentives that provide bonuses on top of the delivery fare. 

🌭 For example, the same 4 km delivery during a high demand period with a 50% bonus would be compensated at 5,10 EUR, calculated as follows:
(1,05 EUR pick-up + 1,05 EUR drop-off + 3,00 EUR distance) * 1.5 bonus = 5,10 EUR

📮 If you have any questions, please contact us via the app or send us a message to latvia-food@bolt.eu or check the Bolt support page

1. Support darba laiks šobrīd ir sekojošs: pirmdiena, otrdiena, trešdiena, ceturtdiena, sestdiena, svētdiena no 09:00-23:00, piektdiena no 09:00-01:00. Jums būs iespēja sekot: 
💡 Aktivitātei;
💡 Klientu vērtējumiem;
💡 Piegādāto pasūtījumu skaitam;

💡 Nobrauktajai distancei (km)

Aktivitāte:
Aktivitāte norāda jūsu aptiprināto pasūtījumu procentuālo vērtību (%). Jūsu aktivitāte ir ļoti svarīga, to izmanto, lai noteiktu jūsu piemērotību noteiktām kampaņām. Aktivitāti var negatīvi ietekmēt neapstiprināti vai noraidīti pasūtījumi.

Piemēram: no 10 ienākošajiem pasūtījumiem esat pieņēmis 8 pasūtījumus - jūsu aktivitāte ir 80%. Aktivitāte tiek atjaunināta uzreiz pēc tam, kad esat pieņēmis, noraidījis vai neapstiprinājis ienākošo pasūtījumu.

Klientu vērtējumi:
Mūsu klienti var vērtēt piegādes pieredzi pēc katra pasūtījuma. Vērtējumi tiek aprēķināti, lai iegūtu jūsu vidējo rezultātu. Ja vidējais vērtējuma rezultāts nokrītas zem paredzētā sliekšņa, jūsu konts var tikt īslaicīgi vai neatgriezeniski bloķēts.

Klientu vērtējums tiek aprēķināts, ja jums ir vismaz 8 vērtēti pasūtījumi (šī informacija neatjaunojas uzreiz). 
Piemēram: no 10 pasūtījumiem esat saņēmis 9 pozitīvus un 1 negatīvu vērtējumu, tas nozīmē, ka jūsu vidējais klientu vērtējums būs 0.90 bet maksimālais vērtējums ir 1.0

Šeit ir daži padomi, kā iegūt augstākus vērtējumus:
💡Esiet jauks un pieklājīgs
💡Nodrošiniet tīru somu un drēbes
💡Vienmēr ievērojiet klientu piezīmes
💡Komunicējiet pieklājīgi, profesionāli un cieņpilni
💡Esiet uzmanīgs veicot piegādi
💡Lietojiet sejas masku

Piegādāto pasūtījumu skaits:
Kopējais izpildīto piegāžu skaits konkrētā laika periodā.

Bruto ienākumi: 
Jūsu kopējie bruto ienākumi noteiktā laika periodā, atskaitot manuāli pievienotās kompensācijas.

Skaidras naudas darījumi:
Visu skaidrā naudā veikto darījumu summa, kuru esat veicis noteiktā laika periodā (skaidras naudas pasūtījumu saņemšana un nodošana).

Piemēram: Jūs esat saņēmis 10€ no klienta, tas nozīmē, ka jūsu skaidras naudas balanss tagad ir -10€.
Ja pēc tam, veicot citu piegādi, restorānā jāmaksā 8€, lai saņemtu pasūtījumu, jūsu balanss kļūs -10€ + 8€ = -2€.

Nobrauktā distance:
Nobrauktais attālums no vietas, kur jūs pieņēmāt pasūtījumu līdz restorānam, un no restorāna līdz klientam. Attālums tiek mērīts kilometros norādot mūsu aptuvenos distances aprēķinus
(īsākos maršrutus saskaņā ar Google Maps), bet ne faktisko distanci ko jūs veicāt.

You’ll be able to review:

Acceptance rate:
Acceptance rate represents the percentage (%) of all the orders that you accepted. Your acceptance rate is very important and is used to determine your eligibility for certain campaigns. It may be affected by missed or rejected order requests.

For example: out of 10 orders you have accepted 8 orders, which means that your acceptance rate is 80%. Acceptance rate is updated instantly after you have accepted, rejected or missed the new order.

Customer rating:
Our customers can rate their delivery experience after every order. The ratings are calculated to give your average score. If the average rating score drops below the expected threshold, your account may be temporarily or permanently blocked.

Customer rating is calculated if you have at least 8 rated orders and is NOT updated instantly.
For example: out of 10 orders you have received 9 positive and 1 negative ratings, this means your average customer rating will be 0.90. Maximum rating is 1.0. 

Here are some tips to help you get higher ratings:
💡Be nice and polite
💡Keep your bag and clothes clean
💡Always follow customer notes
💡Keep your conversation polite, professional and respectful
💡Be careful with food
💡Wear a face mask

Completed deliveries:
Your completed deliveries within a certain time period.

Gross earnings:
Your total gross earnings for a certain time period excluding manually added compensations.

Cash transactions:
The sum of all cash transactions you have completed over a certain time period (cash drop-offs and cash pick-ups). 

For example: You have received 10€ from a customer, this means your cash transaction value now is -10€.
If after that, you pay 8€, at the restaurant, to pick up the order, your cash transaction value will become -10€ + 8€ = -2€.

Travelled distance:
Distance travelled from the point where you accepted the order to the restaurant and from the restaurant to the customer. Distance will be shown in km and will represent our estimates (shortest possible routes according to Google Maps) and not the real distance you travelled.

From October 11 an emergency situation will be declared in Latvia and serious restrictions will take effect. 

Receiving orders from shopping centers

We have received information from the management of several shopping centres that couriers will also be checked for a COVID-19 vaccination certificate at the entrance to the store. Without a certificate, it will not be possible to receive orders from restaurants located in supermarkets. If you have valid certificate, please confirm it here: [link]

If you do not have a certificate, then you will receive orders from other restaurants that are not located indoors in supermarkets!

If you have an active certificate, please keep it on your phone, an easy-to-find place or print it out and carry it with you before entering the shopping center. Remember that the certificate is not valid without a personal identification document, so you must always carry a passport, ID card or residence permit. A driver licence is not a personal identification document.

Wearing face masks

The rules on wearing face masks in public spaces (shops, petrol stations, stairways of buildings, etc.) apply to everyone in full. Also, do not forget to keep a safe distance of at least 2 meters. All deliveries are contactless, please do not handle orders into the hands of customers.

Your safety 

Observe personal hygiene norms, wash your hands frequently, reduce contact with each other. If you feel sick, please stay at home and don't make deliveries. Be responsible to yourself and others!

In case of any questions, please contact customer support by text from the Courier application or by e-mail: latvia-food@bolt.eu

Hey! 👋

We wanted to inform you about some recent changes regarding cash orders and Bolt Balance that will affect your interactions with clients. 

Effective immediately, there has been a modification to the way cash orders are handled in relation to Bolt Balance. Previously, if an client paid with cash and provided an amount greater than the order price, you were able to return the excess amount to their Bolt Balance. However, we are required to deprecate this functionality.

To comply with the new regulations, we have implemented a restriction on the maximum amount of excess cash that can be returned to the clients' Bolt Balance. Regardless of the amount they provide, you will only be able to return a maximum of 20 EUR in excess from the total order price to Bolt Balance. 

💡 Here's an examples to illustrate the change: 👇

1️⃣ If the order costs 10 EUR and the client pays with 30 EUR, you will be able to return 20 EUR to the client's Bolt Balance, which complies with the new regulations. ✅
2️⃣ If the order costs 20 EUR and the client pays with 50 EUR, you won't be able to return 30 EUR to the client's Bolt Balance. 
IMPORTANT: 👆In these situations collect the 50 EUR, mark order as paid with 40 EUR and inform the client to contact the customer support to receive another 10 EUR on Bolt Balance. 

Repeating - you will only be able to return a maximum of 20 EUR in excess from the total order price to Bolt Balance ❗️

We understand that this change may cause some inconvenience for cash users, but currently, we do not have any alternative options available. Our engineering team is actively working on finding a suitable solution, and we will keep you updated as any new developments arise.

📩 If you have any questions or concerns regarding these changes, please don't hesitate to reach out to our support team. We value your feedback and are here to assist you during this transition period.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

Hey Couriers! 👋
We would like to inform you about some important updates to our operational procedures, effective starting next week (19.06.2023) .
These changes are specifically applicable to unattended deliveries, where the customer is not present at the delivery location, is not reachable.
💡Please read the following instructions carefully to ensure a smooth implementation:
For all orders, in case you are not able to get in touch with the customer, do the following
1️⃣ Ring/knock the door or building for the customer’s attention
2️⃣ In case there is no response, please try the following:
3️⃣ Call the customer at least 3 times in a 5-minute frame to inform them of your arrival.
If the customer is still unresponsive, follow the appropriate process below:
1️⃣ Take a photo of the order with the apartment/building number visible ensuring the photo captures the order and the customer’s apartment number or any other visible identifier.
2️⃣ Take a screenshot of the calls made to the customer
3️⃣ Send the photo of the order and the screenshot of the calls to Support with a message customer is not responding
❗️Cashless Orders (No Alcohol or any other products with age restrictions) - Unattended Deliveries:
💡After following the above steps, in case of no contact with customer and sending pictures to CS, leave the order at the customer’s door or where the customer has asked (in case there is a note to the order).
❗️Cashless Orders (With Alcohol or any other products with age restrictions) - Unattended Deliveries:
💡For cashless orders containing alcohol and unattended deliveries, after following the above steps, in case of no contact with customer and sending pictures to CS, it is crucial that you do not leave the order at the customer’s door under any circumstances. In such cases, please dispose the order.
👆 If the order is from Bolt Market - please return it to the store and contact the support team to receive compensation. ❗️
❗️Cash Orders - Unattended Deliveries:
💡If the order is a cash order and the customer is not present for delivery, after following the above steps, in case of no contact with customer and sending pictures to CS, please dispose the order and enter “0” as received amount from client. Then mark order as delivered.
💡For Bolt Market orders: If the customer doesn’t fetch the order or cannot verify their age, please return the order to the Bolt Market store you received it from.
Note: 👆 Cash orders (unpaid) should not be left at customer doors under any circumstances, as these orders have not been paid for yet.
Note: All these measures are taken to prevent customers from blaming our devoted couriers in case they complain that they never received the food. This process ensures we have enough evidence to make the case that you tried your best in delivering the food. Hope it helps!

1️⃣ Nofotografējiet pasūtījumu ar redzamu dzīvokļa/ēkas numuru, nodrošinot, ka fotoattēlā ir fiksēts pasūtījums un klienta dzīvokļa numurs vai kāds cits redzams identifikators.
2️⃣ Uzņemiet klientam veikto zvanu ekrānuzņēmumu

📍 Mēs ieviešam jaunu funkciju, lai uzlabotu samaksas sistēmu un paaugstinātu kurjeru ieņēmumus pīķu stundu laikā. 🤑

Kas ir paaugstinātā pieprasījuma samaksa (Surge pricing)?
Surge Pricing ir dinamiska cenu noteikšanas sistēma, kas ļauj mums palielināt kurjeru ieņēmumus, pamatojoties uz pieprasījumu un citiem faktoriem maksimālās slodzes laikā. Tas nodrošina, ka jūs saņemat papildu atlīdzību, ja pieprasījums pēc piegādēm ir liels, un tādējādi mudina jūs izmantot šo iespēju nopelnīt.

Kā darbojas paaugstinātā pieprasījuma samaksa?
Reizinātājs lietotnē atspoguļos paaugstināto pieprasījumu, kas tiks reizināts kopā ar plānotajiem reizinātājiem norādītiem Google Sites.
Pieņemsim, ka plānotais reizinātājs ir x1.5 . Ja kurjera lietotnē piegādes apstiprināšanas laikā pamanāt, ka paaugstinātā pieprasījuma reizinātājs ir x1.2, jūsu ieņēmumi par konkrēto piegādi tiks aprēķināti, reizinot plānoto reizinātāju ar pieprasījuma reizinātāju. 1.5 x 1.2 = 1.8. 🔥

Kā jūs tiksiet informēts?
Lai nodrošinātu, ka visa nepieciešamā informācija jums ir pie rokas, mēs turpināsim kopīgot visus tarifus, izmantojot Telegram kanālu ar novirzi uz Google saiti, un tagad informācija par paaugstinātā pieprasījuma samaksu būs pieejama arī kurjeru lietotnē. Lai redzētu šo funkciju, pārliecinieties, ka izmantojat jaunāko lietotnes versiju, un atjauniniet lietotni, ja ir pieejama jaunāka versija. Pirms katras piegādes apstiprināšanas jūs varēsiet redzēt samaksu par piegādi, kas ietvers konkrētos periodos piemērojamos pieauguma reizinātājus. Šī pārskatāmība palīdzēs jums efektīvāk plānot piegādes un palielināt jūsu ieņēmumus.
Ja jums ir kādi jautājumi, lūdzu, sazinaties ar mūsu klientu atbalsta komandu.

What is Surge Pricing?
Surge Pricing is a dynamic pricing system that allows us to increase courier earnings based on demand and other factors during peak times. It ensures that you receive additional compensation when the demand for deliveries is high, and thus encourages you to take advantage of these busy periods.

How does Surge Pricing work?
The multiplier represents the surge factor, which is applied to the standard scheduled pricing in Telegram.
For example, let’s consider that scheduled multiplier is x1.5 . If you check your courier app and notice that the surge multiplier is x1.2, your earnings for that particular delivery would be calculated by multiplying the scheduled pricing by the surge multiplier. 1.5 x 1.2 = 1.8. 🔥

We will continue to share the courier tariffs via Telegram channel with the link to pricing on Google Site, and now, surge pricing information will also be available on your courier app. In order to see this feature, make sure that you are using the latest version of the app, and update the app if you are not. Before accepting any order, you will be able to see the upfront earnings, which will include the surge multipliers applicable during specific periods. This transparency will help you plan your deliveries more effectively and maximize your earnings.
If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out to our customer support team.
